environment.web: Chromium; production Web bundle and deterministic native bridge fixtures

suites.name: TransferReportTests
passedCases: Symbolic links are skipped by default and preserved only by explicit choice
Exports retain the actual comparison settings and engine version without environment data
A large valid selection is split into bounded, reconstructable configuration records
Comparison candidates never count as completed transfers
Successful copy and later move-source deletion failure remain separate
Retries retain error evidence and do not pretend events are unique files
Growing-file retries separate completed bytes from failed size-verification bytes
A successful retry stays out of the error list and missing copy sizes stay explicit
Ignored links and special files are discoverable in skipped records
Cleanup failures are visible even when rclone logs them at info level
Size diagnostics reject malformed numbers and never reconstruct truncated names
Size-failure history remains bounded during large error sets
JSONL preserves quotes, Unicode and literal newlines in reported filenames
Dry Run actions are planned and statistics never create file rows
Unknown comparison lines and an incomplete tail are visible without invented paths
Reported paths cannot trigger file operations
Filesystem and global errors remain visible without a fake filename
Page cursors retain stable row boundaries and enforce small pages
Saved summaries allow known finite counters and keep uncertain counts unknown
Legacy or queued jobs without a ledger return an unavailable empty page
Both export formats are immutable snapshots while the live job grows
Static JSON export omits a crash-truncated final JSON record
Cleanup removes only owned reports and snapshots; readers reject symlinks
Real rclone copy, repeat sync and delete produce honest checks and separate outcomes
Real rclone preserves symbolic links locally and round-trips cloud-style link files
suites.linkFixture: Local symbolic links are preserved; source-only and destination-only local links options model .rclonelink storage and restoration.

suites.name: Linux compatibility helper smoke
passedCases: bootstrap, engine discovery and Unicode listing
account setup preserves its engine while appearance applies immediately
dry run reports planned work without changing files
copy preserves destination-only files
repeat sync skips unchanged files and removes destination extras
complete reports and task export/import
graceful cancellation cleans partials and preserves completed files
restart clears successful history and retains stopped jobs and tasks
